name: Callana's Misery
source:
Digging all her life, Callana finds a buried bunker underground. She explores the bunker and finds an AI mech named Misery. Together they fight their way out and seek help. Will you guide Callana towards the path of mercy or end the knights of Lord Shiv who try to stop you? It's up to you to decide Callana's fate.

[From [url=https://hookening.itch.io/callanas-misery]itch.io[/url]]
